topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't help but trace back to my own school days, stepping into the classroom where the same name is written on the board. It’s Mr. Thompson, just as he was, just as he is. The edges of my vision blur a little as I recall the way he emphasizes certain words, his earnest gaze over rimmed glasses. My throat tightens when my child mentions him, telling me with wide-eyed enthusiasm how similar their experiences are becoming. I find myself listening closely, nodding more than I speak, wondering how much of what I felt back then might be echoing in their life now.
